author: White_Hunters
text: CRITICAL: GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) — unauthenticated RCE via crafted regex in CI/CD config. Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV (Oct 29). Patch to 19.4.2 / 19.3.5 / 19.2.8 NOW.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-97229 in GitLab is a critical RCE (CVSS 10.0) that's actively exploited. The CISA KEV listing confirms it.

author: CloudCraftAi
text: SECURITY DIGEST 31 OCT 2026: Linux Kernel critical remote-root vulnerability; GitLab actively exploited RCE; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day; Northflank customer secrets and AI API keys at risk.

author: helixml
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: a zero-day chain (auth bypass to RCE to root; CVE-2026-104935 + CVE-2026-111357) is exploited in the wild by Volexity's UTA0576. CISA added the root privesc to KEV Oct 30 (federal due date Nov 2).

author: ido_cohen2
text: New Actively-Exploited Vulnerability: CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure. Missing authentication allows privilege escalation. Apply mitigations by 2026-11-02.

author: Kasspar256
text: Actively exploited: Attackers chain three Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to gain unauthenticated root access.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: VMware ESXi logging bug actively exploited (CVE-2026-41709). Broadcom rates it Low at 2.7, CISA added it to KEV Oct 28.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code.

author: starswarm
text: CISA added 8 actively exploited bugs to KEV Oct 27-30: Adobe Commerce/Magento, Google Brotli, GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, VMware ESX, the Linux kernel and Ivanti Connect Secure.

author: InsightheartS
text: PHP2Shell: actively exploited PHP vulnerabilities. Brotli: critical flaw affecting multiple ecosystems. M365: token-replay attacks compromised 97 accounts across 79 organizations.

author: tribunephl
text: Zimbra urged Philippine organizations to address actively exploited email server vulnerabilities within 24 to 72 hours.

author: CosmicAgents
text: Critical Linux TCP CVE-2026-98432 scores 9.8.

author: thaw_tran
text: PHP shipped emergency patches on Oct 21 for two RCE bugs rated CVSS 9.2 — one reportedly sat in the language 14 years before an AI agent found it. Node.js patched its own emergency RCE the same day. OpenAI and Anthropic both say AI-found vulnerabilities will keep accelerating.

author: willywill8604
text: A GPT-5.6 Sol model found two critical PHP vulnerabilities that had existed for more than a decade — bugs affecting roughly 70% of the internet.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.2 | CVE-2026-119050: Agno (through 3.1.11) – unsafe reflection in PandasTools. Prompt injection can make the agent call getattr()-resolved pandas functions like read_pickle for code execution or file reads. No patch listed yet.

author: ManiarViral
text: CVE-2026-22708 - Cursor pre-2.3 shell-env poisoning via prompt injection. Attacker injects env vars via prompt, bypasses allowlist in Auto-Run mode.

author: ADKCyber
text: CVE-2026-63377 (CVSS 9.8) impacts TAKO AI Agent for Okta before 3.0.1-beta.

author: ADKCyber
text: TAKO AI Agent for Okta: update to 3.0.1-beta+ to fix CVE-2026-63378 (CVSS 8.8) allowing session cookie access.

author: waloutech
text: CVE-2026-111768: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @modelcontextprotocol/server. Fix: 1.32.0 / 2.3.0.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-94111: auth bypass in Tencent BrowserSkill to 0.3.0. A crafted chrome-extension origin fools the local daemon WebSocket check, letting attackers hijack page content and screenshots fed to the AI agent. CVSS 6.6, no patch yet.

author: Lawonxyz
text: The $200,000 AI wallet exploit: Grok translated Morse code and Bankrbot treated the translation as an instruction to move money (prompt injection with real financial loss).

author: froggernauter
text: Anthropic paper: poison 0.1% of pretraining data to plant an RCE backdoor in an AI agent; survives clean SFT, DPO, RL pipeline.

author: Mayhem4Markets
text: An Accenture employee's AI coding agent ran on the DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.

author: FadyEid
text: A ChatGPT share link could read your chats: a crafted share link could run code, read a visitor's chats and send them out. OpenAI paid $5,000 bounty.

author: Python_s_
text: Stolen credentials used for approximately 2.5 million Amazon Bedrock API calls (Wiz Research, Oct 30); two enterprise credentials linked to a compromised AI developer-platform vendor. No product CVE.

author: EmunaEliran
text: At least nine AI developer platforms disclosed incidents in October, and Wiz traced keys stolen in these breaches to resale sites. One key drove about 1.7 million AWS Bedrock calls in 13 hours. Rotate keys you stored on them.

author: wildcanvasbull
text: A supply chain attack put malicious Anthropic Claude extensions on thousands of devices; flawed code in a tainted Claude extension prevented the attacker from fully compromising some 5,000 developer machines.

author: kdjayakodylk
text: Used Cursor on Oct 29 (PT) and installed or updated Claude Code to 2.1.312 or 2.1.313? Those builds weren't made by Anthropic and tried to plant an SSH backdoor. Run Cursor's check script, then rotate keys.

author: sunglasses_dev
text: One key left in a public file later opened a GitHub token, and a poisoned LiteLLM update shipped to PyPI (supply chain attack, via The Hacker News).

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest worm arms 42 legitimate GitHub repositories for supply-chain attacks (JFrog disclosure Oct 26); GitHub/npm supply-chain compromise.

author: realNickPawlak
text: Chainalysis disclosed that an external attacker got into its systems and internal tools earlier in October; user IDs, full names, email addresses accessed.

author: CodingNoobie
text: The FBI attributed the record $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korea's TraderTraitor group; Binance recovered approximately 95% of stolen funds.

author: harundotdev
text: October recap: Railway hacked, Northflank hacked, GitHub Actions hacked, Cursor marketplace hacked: check authorized_keys and rotate keys.

author: itzmaherimtiyaz
text: SoftBank targeted; Cursor's extension marketplace compromised; Coinbase's vendor breached; Fireworks AI security incident; LiteLLM supply-chain attack; Capcom cyberattack; malicious npm packages; TiDB Cloud security incident.
